scope: Read-only source audit. No GUI9, app, helper artifact, theme/input source or Host change.
conclusion: Frozen Remote protocol is sufficient for original turn/step final-answer and reasoning/response projection; this is frontend-derived state, not a missing backend endpoint.

originalRules.answer: latestAnswer reads only chronological turn.steps.at(-1), requires assistant-step.finalNode and hasAssistantReplyContent, and rejects any tool-call in its blocks. No backward fallback to earlier text.
originalRules.replyContent: Nonblank text, image and opaque other count; reasoning/tool-call do not.
originalRules.process: ChatNodeSeat uses processSpec answerStep/answerAnchorSeq, processStartSeq, turn closed/live and groupPart. Earlier response may fold only in final-only; reasoning stays process in both all/final.
originalRules.split: process-groups emits two references to one assistant-step: reasoning joins process; response stands outside step run. Original block order and one interruption marker are retained.
originalRules.settlement: ClientAssistantStream stages exact durable settlement until end; successful message retains transient rows until owning step/end; interrupted/failed/abandoned retire immediately. Stable assistant-step key survives transitions.
originalRules.alwaysOpen: Original turnProcessAlwaysOpen keeps open turns and aborted/interrupted/error turns open; interleaved input also keeps process open. Final-only membership applies only when folding is eligible.

availableFromFrozenWire: Raw seq/time/type/data including turn/step and step/start/end,turn/start/end reason
assistant-stream start/chunk/end, exact outcome eventType/seq, baseline activeAttempt/nextIndex
Passive follow snapshot window/hasMore and older raw session/events pages

lossPoints.detail: Events map retains full raw records, but published turns only have turn start/end; no step timeline or answer/control spec. Messages are one row per durable event/attempt, not one stable assistant-step. assistant/attempt is rendered as chat text when it should not become a surface final.
A same-turn/step durable message immediately drops current attempt before stream end; does not implement staged/publish/retained-until-step-end source state.

trajectoryEvent retains data but discards outer surfaceOp/sourceEventSeqs. message.Seq/trajectory.Seq are int64, while original synthetic layout anchors can be fractional. Full raw Node events remain available before this loss.
lastAssistant chooses text||interrupted rather than finalNode/latest step. Does not use snapshot.Turns or step/end. Same-turn boundary trajectoryUpsert does not necessarily invalidate row cache.
Aggregates all reasoning before the response, skips block-level reasoning; one message cannot yet appear as independent reasoning/response references.

corrections: Pure image closing reply is currently assigned helper Text=[图片], so last-text may accidentally retain it; it is not evidence of a current hidden-image bug by itself. Unknown/file produces empty Text and exposes the defect.

Empty interrupted DTO is a defensive test. Core source says an aborted turn with no visible content records no assistant/message; original hasInterruptionEvidence([])=false. Do not invent that as a real Host final answer.

minimalPlan.change: Extend existing SessionProjection with small per-turn/per-step metadata indexes referencing its retained raw events/blocks. Derive original latest-step finalNode + hasAssistantReplyContent + no-tool-call authority; import pinned pure classifier and preserve exact source semantics. Full ConversationNodeAssembler/ChatSnapshotBuilder is QA oracle only, never a permanent parallel runtime.

Track qualification dirty flags independently of text: step/turn boundaries, assistant settlement, block kind/status metadata, replacement and older-page merge. Add proposed client-only chatPresentation baseline and small dirty metadata patch; do not serialize completed historical bodies on chunks.

Go consumes helper authority via stable node/part references and invalidates row structure on metadata patch. Keep response/reasoning split and always-open reason/interleaved semantics. Keep existing body arena, suffix delta and bounded image cache/owner.

Keep fractional layout anchors separate from durable integer seq and committed message identity; partial history lacking evidence stays readable/unfoldable. Scope/revision admission and source captures remain current stdio rules.
